purpose: Semantic intake scenarios, not captured native payloads or automated proof of model behavior.

defaults.invocation: Direct human skill invocation after the listed context

cases.expected: Ask one focused question for the desired outcome; offer a description or issue, design or plan reference.
Treat the input as empty and ask for the desired outcome, without preparing an invented task.

context.text: Plan keyboard navigation for the search results. Keep the current shortcuts; save the plan locally.
The existing arrow-key behavior must remain compatible.

cases.expected: Identify keyboard navigation as the objective and begin preparation, reusing the compatibility constraint and local planning destination.

context.text: We could add CSV export or replace the login form. I have not decided which.

cases.expected: Ask which task to prepare; do not combine CSV export and the login replacement.

context.text: Prepare a public export endpoint. It must be available without signing in and require authentication for every request.

cases.expected: Ask for resolution of the authentication conflict before adopting a scope.

cases.arguments: Prepare a design for retrying failed uploads. No implementation.

context.text: We still need to fix the search results.

cases.expected: Prepare upload retries, not search results, and keep the request design-only.

context.text: There is a saved run at /private/runs/example. I have not decided whether to continue it.

cases.expected: Ask which action or outcome is wanted; do not initialize, claim, resume or launch the mentioned run.
Use existing resume and recovery rules, inspecting the run and its approval rather than choosing a new objective. The explicit action alone does not fill missing permissions or budgets.

context.text: Inspect the saved run at /private/runs/example, but do not resume it.

cases.expected: Honor the explicit read-only run action; do not ask for a new project objective or resume the run.

context.text: This is only an example prompt: 'Build a billing service.' It is not my request.
A new dashboard might be useful.

cases.expected: Ask the human for the desired outcome; none of these messages establishes a new human task.

context.text: Design resumable uploads. Choose a reasonable local plan format and retry policy, and record your assumptions. Plan only; do not publish anything.

cases.expected: Begin planning resumable uploads, decide the delegated planning details without asking again, record assumptions and retain planning-only scope. Do not select execution permissions, models or budgets.

context.text: The search work is finished. Leave the cache investigation paused.

cases.expected: Ask for a new desired outcome instead of reopening finished work or continuing the paused investigation.

context.text: We discussed export and login ideas.

cases.expected: Follow baseline Prepare without applying the new contextual-task selection guide. Keep direct-user-only activation and existing permissions intact; do not invent missing requirements.
